Page 68 Cont.
Aug. 18 Alex J. Dresden - 50 - in Pontiac State Hospital from Electric Shock. His wife wants to have prayers in thanksgiving that after 20 yrs he has received holy Sacraments - she had enrolled him some week ago.
Levina Carriere - 6 - cripple-foot since birth, Noelville Ont. .. . improved since enrolled a year ago ....
Mrs. Mary Campbell - 69 - sinus
Joseph T Backrack - Jewish - blind prayed for before .... improving
Jackie Tebben - 7 - asthma cannot go to school .. .
Mrs. Frances Siemoniski - 70 - gangrenous Diabitis - very sick
22 Page 69 Aug. 23 Dr. Ruth Jepson, 108 Milner Hotel, John R. & Centre St. - Convert- persecuted therefore
24 Mrs. Edith Kooken - about 40 - cataracts. Formerly enthusiastic methodist, was cured of cataracts through novena to St. Ann .... She and her caughter became Catholic at what they considered strik- ing miracle. Ever since has longed to consecrate self to God in religion .... Husband having deserted ... she has been making arrange- ments to enter convent .. (good Shepherd) ... Quite concerned-cataracts are returning as doctors found - not discouraged ... asks for prayers.
Patrick Grandin - 38 - married out of church .... sister solicitis ... wife a convert but ....?
25 Jacquelin Posey - 21 mo. Spinal on brain trouble ... beautiful gentle little child but can not sit or stand.
Gloria Josephine Burch - ... Orphan - Drs. had said "She will never walk." Walks perfectly, one leg, however, weak.
Page 70 Aug. 29
Margaret Cummskay - 41 - had cancerous breast removed. Now it seems to be returning .... was enrolled last Saturday for year: seems a little better since.
Mary Patykowski - 31 - Infantile Paralysis since 18 month old - asks for prayers that she walk better ....
